EnvelopeFactory.notes: The V/Oct input is given the cv family rather than pitch: it scales stage times by octaves rather than setting an audible pitch, which is the ruling in STYLE.md. The AMP and OFF inputs and the INV output change meaning when VCA mode is chosen on the module menu, becoming an audio input, a velocity input and a VCA output; their families are given for the default, non-VCA, behaviour. The census records every stage's controls at the same panel position, because a stage is one child widget with its own coordinate frame; the stage tags are therefore assigned by index rather than by position, which is safe here since all 20 stages are identical and laid out left to right in index order.
